name: Data Platform Engineer
description: Builds and operates the enterprise data platform within Data Engineering, supporting the Data & AI value stream. Designs target-state data architecture, translates logical models into physical schemas, and maintains reference architecture patterns. Enforces platform compliance and architecture governance, monitors performance and cost, and reviews access entitlements against least-privilege standards.

name: Data Privacy Steward
description: Administers data privacy controls across the Data & AI value stream, monitoring control effectiveness and reporting privacy metrics to the Chief Privacy Officer. Supports data quality remediation, reference and master data governance, and lifecycle management. Publishes certified data assets, flags deprecated datasets, and approves reference data changes through the governance workflow.

name: Data Product Owner
description: Owns the framing and prioritization of AI and analytics use cases across the Data & AI value stream, extending into actuarial, reinsurance, and risk domains. Produces use-case briefs, specifies analytics requirements, and secures governance pre-approval. Supports model risk management by documenting validation findings, tracking remediation to closure, and validating model outputs against benchmarks.

name: Data Protection Officer
description: Oversees privacy and regulatory compliance within Risk, Compliance & Audit, leading compliance testing, regulatory change management, and market conduct examination support. Manages control deficiencies by validating closure evidence and re-testing remediated controls. Maintains the model inventory with risk tiering, monitors key risk indicators, and tracks corrective-action remediation from examinations.

name: Data Protection Specialist
description: Performs privacy operations within Compliance, handling privacy rights requests and breach management across the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream. Executes data subject deletion and correction requests within SLA, issues breach notifications on deadline, and conducts privacy impact assessments. Governs vendor data processing by negotiating DPA and BAA terms and validating vendor privacy controls.

name: Data Quality Analyst
description: Performs data quality monitoring across the Data & AI value stream, defining quality rules and thresholds and enforcing enterprise data standards. Establishes data classification tiers and handling rules, curates business definitions in the data catalog, and processes data access requests. Supports privacy controls by responding to data subject access requests and onboarding stewards with governance training.

name: Data Quality Manager
description: Leads data quality and privacy control monitoring across the Data & AI value stream, triaging quality exceptions, driving remediation, and validating corrections against quality rules. Manages reference data and master data domain definitions, approving changes through governance workflow. Publishes certified data assets, flags deprecated datasets, and reports privacy metrics to the Chief Privacy Officer.

name: Data Science Lead
description: Leads AI use-case framing and advanced analytics delivery across the Data & AI value stream, with significant work in actuarial, reinsurance, and risk domains. Directs model risk management by validating model outputs against benchmarks, documenting findings, and tracking remediation to closure. Supports regulatory model-use filings, economic capital modeling, and predictive rating model development.

name: Data Scientist
description: Performs model training, validation, and predictive analytics across the Data & AI value stream, with substantial contributions to actuarial, finance, and workforce analytics. Develops predictive rating models, scores customers into propensity deciles, and runs stress-scenario and tax-impact modeling. Supports AIOps model governance and assesses GenAI use cases against risk guardrails on model governance platforms.

name: Data Steward
description: Administers reference and master data across the Data & AI value stream, validating updates against authoritative sources and publishing approved reference data to the enterprise store. Defines enterprise data standards and classification tiers, curates business definitions, and executes matching algorithms for master data domains. Supports privacy controls including data subject access requests.

name: Database Administrator
description: Administers backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery infrastructure supporting the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream. Manages backup platform capacity, configures DR data replication to defined RPO targets, and executes annual Tier 1 failover tests. Validates data restoration for critical systems, maintains continuity plans against the threat register, and reports resilience readiness for regulatory and cyber-continuity requirements.

name: Delegated Authority Analyst
description: Performs delegated-authority operations within Underwriting, administering reinsurance programs by screening treaties for retention, referring over-retention cases, and preparing quarterly and annual bordereaux. Supports policy binding and mid-term endorsement processing, revising and re-issuing quotes to brokers. Validates appetite guideline changes against capital and reinsurance terms and reports portfolio status to committee.

name: Delegated Authority Manager
description: Leads delegated-authority governance within Underwriting, overseeing reinsurance program administration, appetite guideline management, and underwriting quality assurance. Directs treaty retention screening, referral of over-retention cases, and submission of reinsurance bordereaux. Monitors portfolio concentration and appetite exceptions, validates appetite changes against capital and reinsurance terms, and reports status to committee.
